Marissa / team — quick legal read below (high level). I'll follow up with a marked PDF (MSA_ExhibitA_Redline.pdf) by EOD.

• Withholding VAT language: we should avoid open-ended re-invoicing obligations that allow the customer to unilaterally withhold amounts. Proposed approach: (a) confirm Redwood will issue invoices to the billed entity with VAT calculated per jurisdiction, (b) if customer withholds, they must provide supporting tax documentation within 30 days and place withheld amounts in escrow pending resolution.

• Invoicing entity mapping: include a schedule in the Order Form that lists invoiced entity + VAT registration number per line item. That resolves accounting requirements without changing the MSA.

• Minimum commit true-up: legal neutral on cadence, but any change that increases frequency of billing adjustments should include an explicit audit-rights paragraph and an adjustment cap (e.g., adjustments per quarter not exceeding 25% of committed units) to limit disputes.

Deliverables: I'll attach redline wording for the withholding clause and a sample invoiced-entity schedule.

Thanks — finance input below.

1) Quarterly true-up: Finance can operationally support quarterly true-ups provided we receive: (a) per-entity VAT IDs, (b) signed PO or confirmation of invoiced entity at signature, and (c) notification of entity transfers at least 30 days before the quarter-end. Quarterly true-up is our preference.

2) Withholding and escrow: we can accept an escrow mechanism for withheld VAT if Nimbus provides evidence within 30 days and the escrow is held at an agreed third-party escrow agent. Any withheld amounts older than 90 days without documentation will be considered past due and subject to interest.

3) Invoice metadata: we require the following fields on every invoice: invoiced_entity_name; invoiced_entity_address; VAT/Tax ID; billing_period; commitment_band; PO number. If Nimbus cannot provide these consistently, invoices will be issued to the holding company and the customer is responsible for internal allocation.

I'll attach a sample invoice template in the next message.
